reasoning: By the pigeonhole principle, assigning 12 distinct pigeons to 11 holes (0-10) with at most one per hole requires 12 unique hole assignments, which exceeds the available holes.
cot_trace: The problem is: Place 12 pigeons into 11 holes such that each hole contains at most one pigeon. Each pigeon must be assigned to exactly one hole (numbered 0 to 10).
